title: Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – July 25, 2019
raw_text: July 25, 2019 Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – July 25, 2019 A new patch is now live on Windows PC. Read below to learn more about the latest changes. To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum. For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum. BUG FIXES General Fixed a bug that made it possible in rare circumstances to lose ultimate charge. Fixed a bug that prevented Competitive Play groups being found in LFG. Fixed rare instances of "avoid as teammate" not working. Heroes Fixed a bug that caused Kendoka Genji to briefly t-pose during the outro for his Meditate emote. Top of post
